clipping.name: Gradient Clipping
clipping.description: Each bank's per-sample gradients are clipped to a maximum L2 norm, bounding the influence of any single traffic record on the update.

noise.name: Gaussian Noise
noise.description: Zero-mean Gaussian noise is added to clipped updates to calibrate differential privacy. Larger noise = stronger privacy, lower utility.

aggregation.name: Trusted Aggregator
aggregation.description: A neutral trusted aggregator performs regional then global weighted averaging. Cryptographic secure aggregation is future work.

scenarios.name: Low Privacy
scenarios.description: Minimal noise to maximise detection quality. Suitable for internal pilot within a single trusted consortium.

scenarios.name: Balanced Privacy
scenarios.description: Default configuration. Moderate noise calibrated to keep cumulative epsilon under 8 across all twelve rounds.

scenarios.name: High Privacy
scenarios.description: Stronger DP guarantee with larger noise multiplier. Trade-off visible on rare classes (INFILTRATION, WEB_ATTACK).

scenarios.name: Strict Privacy
scenarios.description: Very strong differential privacy bound. Demonstrates utility floor; not recommended for production deployment today.
